limitations: External recognizers are proxies, not listeners.
CommonAccent is a 16-class model evaluated on a four-class subset.
GLOBE accents are self-reported and the test split is speaker-disjoint.
CREMA-D is acted speech; fear and disgust are excluded.
The generated set has three voices; generated accuracy is not a speaker-generalization estimate.
A failed domain-shift gate invalidates the generated prediction comparison; it does not prove the synthesis control is wrong.
emotion2vec+ uses the FunASR model license (other); review redistribution terms.
No MOS, CMOS, or human identification study was run.
